name: cartridge-traits-gpt2-v54-twin
command: HF_HOME=/pub/wagnera3/hf TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1 HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 /opt/env/bin/python -m model_trainer.cli.cartridge_trait_sweep --plan gpt2-traits --corpus /pub/wagnera3/mi/traits/corpus --device cuda --out /pub/wagnera3/mi/traits/results/gpt2-traits-v54-twin.json

experiment.what_it_certifies: A2 requires that two runs of the same plan on the same node produce a bit-identical record. This is the second run. No judge model enters the measurement path and the steering arm draws nothing, so the only sources of run-to-run variation are the ones the cartridge arms pin with torch.manual_seed -- and if the two records differ, one of those pins has come loose rather than the traits having changed.
